inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, we are watching a complete failure of leadership and national resolve unfold right before our eyes. While tensions flare in the Middle East, instead of projecting American strength and standing firmly with our greatest ally, our own government sneaked around and proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan. It is an absolute embarrassment to our national sovereignty and our traditional foreign policy. 

And how did the rogue regime in Tehran respond to this weakness? They spat right in our face, presenting five counter-conditions and demanding an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty. This is the inevitable result when feckless leaders try to appease hostile actors instead of backing law, order, and traditional military deterrence. 

Thank God Israel still has some backbone left in this mess. Israel remains sceptical of Iran's acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes, highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict. While our own compromised institutions pursue weak-kneed diplomacy that betrays our values and emboldens our enemies, at least someone in the region understands that national survival requires personal responsibility, strength, and a firm refusal to bow to radicals.
